authoredFrom: M60 SQL wave, 2026-09-27. The shape is read off real PostgreSQL extension files at /usr/share/postgresql/14/extension, not off the analyzer: 122 EXECUTE literals in postgis_topology--2.0.0--3.2.0.sql alone, and the concatenated-fragment form `EXECUTE 'CREATE INDEX ' || quote_ident(x) || ' ON t (c)'` is the one that occurs 94% of the time. Ground truth for the pass is the extension-corpus delta: +156 symbols and +234 relationships over 387 files.
comment: The forbid rows are the regression pins, and they matter more here than the expect rows. A pass that finds the right declarations is easy to write; the defect this fixture exists to catch is a pass that ALSO finds the commented-out ones, and an expect-only fixture would pass unchanged while a ghost table sat in the symbol list. The `quoted_name` row is the offset-fidelity pin: the literal's inner text is handed to the parser WITH its `''` escapes intact, so the recovered range must still point at the right bytes; unescaping first would shift every range after the first escaped quote and this row would stop matching.
